data.case_title: School entrance examination (Schuleingangsuntersuchung) invitation for Paula
data.explanation: The public health office (Gesundheitsamt) of Landkreis Beispielstedt is inviting you to bring your child Paula to the mandatory school entrance health check (Schuleingangsuntersuchung) before she starts school. Bring the yellow child health record booklet, the vaccination card, and glasses or hearing aids if your child uses them. The check is free and takes about an hour. If the date and time do not work for you, call the office to reschedule using the phone number given.
